records.text: A Shattered Hand sentry guarding the faction’s position, this orc calls the blood their power and rallies others for Kargath and victory. In combat, the sentry uses Hamstring to hinder an enemy.

A Shattered Hand savage who rallies for Kargath and victory, this orc calls blood their power and invokes the Illidari in battle. The savage can become enraged, fights with Slice and Dice, and unleashes a Deathblow when slain.

A Shattered Hand brawler who proclaims blood as the faction’s power and rallies for Kargath and victory, this orc closes to striking distance and uses the Curse of the Shattered Hand against nearby foes.
This Shadowmoon acolyte gives voice to the Shattered Hand’s battle cries, declaring blood their power and calling for Kargath and victory. In combat, the acolyte attacks the mind with Mind Blast.
A Shattered Hand reaver who proclaims blood as their power and rallies for Kargath and victory, this orc can become enraged and sweeps nearby foes with a Cleave in combat.

A Shattered Hand legionnaire is one of the Fel Horde’s battle-hardened officer corps under Kargath Bladefist. In combat, he invokes blood as power, calls for support, and reacts with rage when an ally falls.
A Shattered Hand sharpshooter is a Fel Horde combatant stationed in Hellfire Citadel’s Shattered Halls. He is armed for ranged combat and shoots at enemies who come within range.

Grand Warlock Nethekurse is a cruel, mocking warlock who delights in a fight and treats his peons as disposable. He taunts challengers and directs the peons to attack, sometimes ridiculing them as he hands them over.

Warchief Kargath Bladefist claims his faction is the true Horde and himself its only warchief, rejecting Thrall’s Horde. He orders an executioner and threatens captured Thrallmar or Honor Hold forces with death if they intrude into his fortress.
Warbringer O'mrogg is a champion of the Fel Horde who guards its banner. The Warchief's forces seek the banner as a trophy of victory over this rival Horde.
Fel Orc Converts speak in short, distressed cries when struck by Shadow Sear, protesting that it hurts and pleading for the pain to stop.

Randy Whizzlesprocket asks an Alliance visitor to rescue Captain Alina, an important officer among the soldiers captured by Kargath. He says he will find his own way out once he has caught his breath.
Rifleman Brownbeard is a named rifleman encountered in the Hellfire Citadel area.
Captain Alina is an officer captured by Kargath. After her rescue, she thanks the rescuer and says she will gather the remaining prisoners and lead them to Honor Hold.
Private Jacint is a named private encountered in the Hellfire Citadel area.
A Shattered Hand executioner is a combatant in the Shattered Hand's service. It can cast Cleave in combat.
A Creeping Ooze that fights by casting Sticky Ooze.
A Creeping Oozeling that fights by casting Sticky Ooze.
A Shattered Hand heathen whose battle cries promise victory for Kargath and acclaim the Illidari. Calling blood their power, these fighters express fierce allegiance. They become enraged.
A Shattered Hand archer whose role is ranged combat, attacking with Shoot from a distance.
A Shattered Hand Blood Guard who directs archers in battle, ordering them to form ranks and then calling them to readiness and aim. The commands establish a local leadership role.
A Shattered Hand Zealot is a combatant.
A Shattered Hand Gladiator is a combatant. In combat, it uses Mortal Strike.

Shattered Hand Centurions are among the Fel Horde's battle-hardened elite under Kargath Bladefist, serving as officers. This centurion's cries call for Kargath and victory, proclaim blood as power, and urge opponents to fight.
The Rabid Warhound is a beast that attacks with a carnivorous bite and can use a furious howl.
A Shattered Hand Houndmaster whose battle cries pledge victory to Kargath, call blood their power, and claim the world for their side.
A Shattered Hand champion in the Fel Horde’s feared elite officer corps, which serves Kargath Bladefist. Its rallying cries declare blood as power and call for Kargath and victory.
A Shattered Hand scout who warns that invaders have breached the defenses, serving as an alarm for its side.
A Shadowmoon darkcaster whose battle cries praise Kargath and declare blood to be their power. In combat, it uses fear.
A Shattered Hand assassin that uses Wound Poison in combat.

O'mrogg's left head is the more conciliatory voice in the two-headed ogre's combat banter: it proposes letting an opponent live in exchange for kindness, while also urging violence against an enemy's friend.
O'mrogg's right head tries to take charge of the talking, rejects the left head's offer to spare an opponent, and complains that the left head's constant hunger makes them fat.
Blood Guard Porung directs the archers in his encounter, ordering them to form ranks, aim, and fire. He rallies them for Kargath and victory, showing allegiance to Kargath's cause.

place_records.text: You are in The Shattered Halls, a set of halls inside Hellfire Citadel in Hellfire Peninsula. Warchief Kargath Bladefist rules them and claims his faction is the true Horde, rejecting Thrall's Horde. Shattered Hand gladiators and heathens fill the halls, and Grand Warlock Nethekurse, a cruel warlock, taunts challengers and sends his peons against them. Kargath holds captured Alliance soldiers here, among them Captain Alina, who faces execution.
